3	Deep-dive on the YouTube podcast playlist pipeline (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`).
4	
5	## Stage-by-Stage Flow
6	
7	```
8	playlist URL(s)
9	  |-> Episode Enumeration
10	  |     yt-dlp flat extraction (no downloads; returns id, title, duration per entry)
11	  |     pytube fallback if yt-dlp fails
12	  |     Plain video URLs are treated as single-episode playlists
13	  |
14	  |-> Transcript Fetch (per episode)
15	  |     lib/youtube_transcript_enhanced.get_metadata_and_transcript_api_first()
16	  |     Cookie-free youtube-transcript-api + oEmbed metadata
17	  |     No transcript available -> status `no_transcript`, move on
18	  |
19	  |-> Parse + Clean
20	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.clean_transcript()
21	  |     Strips [Music]/[Applause]/[inaudible] cues, dedupes stuck caption
22	  |     lines, normalizes whitespace
23	  |     Cleaned copy saved to data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<video_id>.txt
24	  |
25	  |-> Fidelity Review
26	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.review_transcript() -> FidelityReport
27	  |     Heuristic subscores (weights):
28	  |       coverage   .30  captions cover the episode's yt-dlp duration
29	  |       density    .20  words-per-minute in the 90-220 speech band
30	  |       gaps       .15  largest silence between caption segments
31	  |       artifacts  .15  non-speech cue ratio in raw text
32	  |       repetition .20  duplicate 6-gram windows (stuck captions)
33	  |     Optional --llm-review: samples 3 chunks, asks FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL
34	  |     (default gpt-5.5) for a coherence rating that becomes 1/3 of the score
35	  |     Verdicts: pass >= 0.7 | review 0.45-0.7 | fail < 0.45
36	  |     Report saved to data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<video_id>.fidelity.json
37	  |
38	  |-> Quality Gate
39	  |     verdict `fail` OR score < --min-fidelity -> status `quarantined`
40	  |     (transcript + report kept on disk for human review; NOT ingested)
41	  |
42	  |-> Full Pipeline (main.process_url)
43	        KB storage -> Upstash sync -> NER entity extraction ->
44	        vectorization (--upload -> OpenAI vector store) ->
45	        CocoIndex knowledge graph -> Mem0 memory
46	```
47	
48	## Checkpointing & Resume
49	
50	State lives in `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json`, keyed by video ID:
51	
52	```json
53	{
54	  "videos": {
55	    "dQw4w9WgXcQ": {
56	      "title": "...", "url": "...", "playlist_id": "PL...",
57	      "status": "ingested", "fidelity": 0.87, "doc_id": "abc123",
58	      "updated": "2026-07-23T18:00:00+00:00"
59	    }
60	  }
61	}
62	```
63	
64	- State is written after **every** episode (atomic tmp-file swap), so a crash
65	  or Ctrl-C loses at most the in-flight episode.
66	- Re-running the same playlist skips episodes whose status is `ingested` or
67	  `quarantined`. `no_transcript` and `failed` episodes are retried
68	  automatically. Use `--force` to reprocess everything.
69	- Statuses: `ingested`, `quarantined`, `no_transcript`, `failed`, `dry_run`,
70	  `skipped` (counted per run, not stored).
71	
72	## Output Artifacts
73	
74	| Path | Contents |
75	|------|----------|
76	| `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` | Resume checkpoint (all episodes ever seen) |
77	| `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<id>.txt` | Cleaned transcript (title + URL header) |
78	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<id>.fidelity.json` | Full FidelityReport with subscores + issues |
79	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/run-<ts>.md` | Per-run markdown summary table |
80	
81	## Duplicate Fetch Note
82	
83	The fidelity stage fetches the transcript once for scoring, then
84	`main.process_url()` re-fetches it internally during ingestion. This is
85	deliberate: it keeps `main.py` untouched and the gate fully decoupled. The
86	transcript API is fast and the `--delay` flag (default 2s) keeps request
87	pacing polite. If YouTube rate-limits a long run, raise `--delay`.
88	
89	## Reviewing Quarantined Episodes
90	
91	```bash
92	# List quarantined episodes with their issues
93	python -c "
94	import json
95	s = json.load(open('data/playlist_ingestion/state.json'))
96	for vid, e in s['videos'].items():
97	    if e.get('status') == 'quarantined':
98	        print(f\"{vid}  {e.get('fidelity')}  {e['title'][:60]}\")
99	        for i in e.get('issues', []): print(f'   - {i}')
100	"
101	```
102	
103	To ingest one anyway after manual review, run the standard single-URL path:
104	
105	```bash
106	python main.py "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>" --upload
107	```
108	
109	then update its state entry (or just leave it — `--force` is per-run, and the
110	single-URL path doesn't consult the playlist state file).
111	
112	## Tuning
113	
114	- `--min-fidelity 0.6` — stricter gate for noisy auto-captioned channels
115	- `--llm-review` — worth it for channels with heavy crosstalk; costs one
116	  chat completion per episode (`FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL`, default `gpt-5.5`)
117	- `--limit 5 --dry-run` — cheap preview of a new playlist's caption quality
118	  before committing to a full ingest
119	- Fidelity weights/thresholds live at the top of `lib/transcript_fidelity.py`
120
```

13	
14	# Disclosure RAG Processor
15	
16	Process UFO/UAP research content through a multi-stage pipeline: content extraction, knowledge base storage, entity extraction, knowledge graph construction, and contextual memory.
17	
18	## Working Directory
19	
20	All commands run from `apps/disclosure-rag/`. Activate venv and load env first:
21	
22	```bash
23	cd apps/disclosure-rag && source .venv/bin/activate && source .env
24	```
25	
26	Required: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `UFO_DATA_STORE_ID`. Optional: `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL`/`UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`, `MEM0_API_KEY`, `MEM0_USER_ID`.
27	
28	## CLI Entry Points
29	
30	### main.py -- Primary Processor
31	
32	```bash
33	python main.py <URL_OR_FILE> [--upload] [--no-kb] [--status]
34	```
35	
36	Auto-detects content type (YouTube / web / file). `--upload` sends to OpenAI vector store. `--status` shows all integration backends.
37	
38	### main.sh -- Shell Wrapper
39	
40	```bash
41	./main.sh process-url <URL> [--upload]    # Single URL
42	./main.sh process-file <FILE> [--upload]  # Single file
43	./main.sh process-urls <URL_FILE>         # Batch from file
44	./main.sh search "Phoenix Lights"         # Search KB
45	./main.sh stats                           # KB statistics
46	./main.sh ui                              # Streamlit (port 8501)
47	./main.sh chat                            # Chat interface
48	./main.sh setup                           # Install dependencies
49	./main.sh sync-rag                        # Sync to local RAG
50	```
51	
52	Auto-creates `.venv` if missing, loads `.env`, validates env vars.
53	
54	### cli.py -- Interactive TUI (use for bulk ingestion & research chat)
55	
56	```bash
57	python cli.py
58	```
59	
60	Menu: **Search KB** | **Bulk Ingestion** (folder → all PDFs/DOCX/TXT/MD) | **Research Chat** | **Entity Analysis** | **Geospatial Analysis** | **Reports**. Uses Charm tools (gum/glow/glamour); falls back to plain input if not installed.
61	
62	### run.sh -- Alternative Runner
63	
64	```bash
65	./run.sh chat | agno-chat | agno-chat-files
66	./run.sh process-url --url <URL> --upload
67	./run.sh process-yt --url <YT_URL> --upload
68	./run.sh test | lint | format | clean
69	```
70	
71	## Processing Pipeline
72	
73	```
74	Input (URL/YouTube/File)
75	  |-> Content Extraction
76	  |     YouTube: lib/youtube.py transcript extraction
77	  |     Web: processing/web_content_processor.py scraping
78	  |     File: direct read (supports .md, .pdf, .txt — NOT .docx; use bulk ingestion for docx)
79	  |
80	  |-> Knowledge Base Storage (lib/knowledge_base_crud.py)
81	  |     Indexes content, assigns doc_id
82	  |
83	  |-> Upstash Search Sync (lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py)
84	  |     Syncs to frontend search index (if configured)
85	  |
86	  |-> Entity Extraction (lib/entity_extraction/)
87	  |     NER + Xata database matching (85-95% accuracy)
88	  |     Extracts: personnel, organizations, locations, events
89	  |
90	  |-> CocoIndex Knowledge Graph (lib/cocoindex_integration.py)
91	  |     Builds entity relationships (requires PostgreSQL + Neo4j)
92	  |
93	  |-> Mem0 Contextual Memory (lib/mem0_integration.py)
94	  |     Stores processing summaries, entity memories
95	  |
96	  |-> Upstash Queue (lib/upstash/queue.py)
97	       QStash async processing for downstream consumers
98	```
99	
100	Each stage is fault-tolerant -- failures log warnings but never block the pipeline.
101	
102	## Key Modules
103	
104	| Module | Purpose |
105	|--------|---------|
106	| `lib/knowledge_base_service.py` | Orchestrates KB indexing + Upstash sync |
107	| `lib/knowledge_base_crud.py` | Full CRUD -- see API section below |
108	| `lib/terminal_display.py` | Animated spinners, styled headers, progress output |
109	| `lib/entity_extraction/processors/interactive_entity_processor.py` | NER with `process_summary_file_interactive()` |
110	| `lib/cocoindex_integration.py` | `cocoindex_processor.process_document_knowledge_graph()` |
111	| `lib/mem0_integration.py` | Memory functions -- see API section below |
112	| `lib/unified_rag_orchestrator.py` | `UnifiedRAGOrchestrator` -- async multi-backend search |
113	| `processing/web_content_processor.py` | `WebContentProcessor` for web scraping |
114	| `processing/content_analysis.py` | Content classification and topic detection |
115	| `scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py` | `BulkFolderIngestion` -- multi-format batch processing |
116	| `agents/` | 14 specialized research agents (see Agents section) |
117	| `api_server.py` | FastAPI REST server with RAG search endpoints |
118	
119	## KnowledgeBaseCRUD Full API
120	
121	```python
122	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD
123	kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()
124	
125	kb.create_document(title, content, source, doc_type, metadata, tags)  # returns Document
126	kb.get_document(doc_id)              # returns Optional[Document]
127	kb.list_documents(doc_type, tags, limit, offset)  # returns List[Document]
128	kb.search_documents(query, limit)    # returns List[Dict] with score/snippet
129	kb.update_document(doc_id, title, content, metadata, tags)
130	kb.delete_document(doc_id)          # returns bool
131	kb.bulk_import(directory, doc_type)  # returns List[Document]
132	kb.export_document(doc_id, output_dir)
133	kb.get_statistics()                  # returns {total_documents, total_tags, documents_by_type, popular_tags, last_updated}
134	```
135	
136	`doc_type` values: `'case_file'`, `'transcript'`, `'article'`, `'research'`
137	
138	Storage paths: transcripts → `sources/transcripts/`, articles → `sources/web/`, files → `sources/files/`, research → `research/`
139	
140	## Mem0 Full API
141	
142	```python
143	from lib.mem0_integration import (
144	    add_memory(messages, user_id, agent_id, metadata)     # core add
145	    search_memories(query, user_id, limit)                # semantic search
146	    add_youtube_summary_memory(title, video_url, video_id, summary, tags)
147	    add_web_article_memory(title, url, content, summary, tags)
148	    add_file_content_memory(title, file_path, content, file_type, tags)
149	    add_entity_extraction_memory(doc_id, entities, total_matches, processing_results)
150	    add_knowledge_graph_memory(doc_id, entities_processed, relationships_processed, kg_results)
151	    add_processing_summary_memory(doc_id, title, content_type, processing_steps, final_status)
152	    contextual_add(user_id, text, metadata)               # direct contextual storage
153	    search_context(user_id, query, top_k)                 # retrieve context
154	)
155	```
156	
157	Env: `MEM0_API_KEY` or `NEXT_PUBLIC_MEM0_API_KEY`. Disable with `MEM0_ENABLE=false`. Agent ID: `MEM0_AGENT_ID` (default: `disclosure-rag-agent`).
158	
159	## Entity Extraction -- Entity Types
160	
161	9 entity types extracted from UAP content:
162	
163	| Type | Key Fields |
164	|------|-----------|
165	| `PERSON` | role, credibility(1-10), authority(1-10), bio |
166	| `EVENT` | title, datetime, location(coordinates), metadata |
167	| `ORGANIZATION` | title, specialization, image |
168	| `LOCATION` | coordinates, google_maps_id, city/state |
169	| `TESTIMONY` | claim, source, documentation[] |
170	| `TOPIC` | title, summary, photos |
171	| `DOCUMENT` | embedding(1536d), url, file[] |
172	| `ARTIFACT` | name, origin, images |
173	| `SIGHTING` | shape, duration_seconds, media_link, location |
174	
175	Confidence levels: High (0.9-1.0) → direct DB insert, Medium (0.6-0.8) → flag for review, Low (0.3-0.5) → archive.
176	
177	```python
178	from lib.entity_extraction.processors.interactive_entity_processor import process_summary_file_interactive
179	results = process_summary_file_interactive(
180	    summary_file_path,   # path to text file
181	    video_id,            # doc_id to associate
182	    interactive=False    # True for human review mode
183	)
184	# returns: { total_entities, total_matches, entities, status }
185	```
186	
187	## Specialized Research Agents (`agents/`)
188	
189	14 agents in `agents/` directory, built on Agno framework:
190	
191	| Agent | File | Purpose |

231	## Unified RAG Search
232	
233	```python
234	from lib.unified_rag_orchestrator import UnifiedRAGOrchestrator
235	import asyncio
236	
237	rag = UnifiedRAGOrchestrator(openai_api_key, vector_store_id)
238	results = asyncio.run(rag.search(
239	    query="Phoenix Lights",
240	    max_results=10,
241	    system_preference='auto'  # 'auto', 'openai', 'local'
242	))
243	status = rag.get_system_status()   # { openai: RAGSystemStatus, local: RAGSystemStatus }
244	```
245	
246	## Bulk Ingestion (`scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py`)
247	
248	Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD files. Extracts text, creates triple-RAG documents.
249	
250	**CLI entry point — choose one:**
251	
252	```bash
253	# Option A: Interactive TUI (recommended for first use)
254	python cli.py
255	# → Select "Bulk Ingestion" from menu → enter folder path when prompted
256	
257	# Option B: Run script directly (non-interactive)
258	python scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py
259	# Note: no built-in CLI flags — configure folder_path in the script or use Option C
260	
261	# Option C: Python one-liner
262	python -c "
263	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
264	b = BulkFolderIngestion('/path/to/folder')
265	docs = b.discover_documents()
266	print(f'Found {len(docs)} files')
267	for d in docs: b.create_triple_rag_document(d, b.extract_text_content(d))
268	"
269	```
270	
271	**Python API:**
272	
273	```python
274	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
275	
276	ingestion = BulkFolderIngestion(folder_path, output_dir="ingestion_results")
277	docs = ingestion.discover_documents()           # find all supported files
278	for doc in docs:
279	    text = ingestion.extract_text_content(doc)  # PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD
280	    rag_doc = ingestion.create_triple_rag_document(doc, text)
281	```
282	
283	## Playlist Ingestion (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`)
284	
285	Batch-ingest one or more YouTube podcast playlists end-to-end. Each episode flows through: enumeration → transcript fetch → parse/clean → **fidelity review** (quality gate) → full pipeline (KB storage, NER entity extraction, vectorization, CocoIndex knowledge graph, Mem0).
286	
287	```bash
288	# One or more playlist URLs (plain video URLs also accepted)
289	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL..." [MORE_URLS...]
290	
291	# From a file (one URL per line, # comments allowed), with vector store upload
292	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py --from-file playlists.txt --upload
293	
294	# Preview a new playlist's caption quality without ingesting
295	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --limit 5 --dry-run
296	
297	# Stricter gate + LLM coherence pass (FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL, default gpt-5.5)
298	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --min-fidelity 0.6 --llm-review
299	```
300	
301	Flags: `--upload` (OpenAI vector store), `--no-kb`, `--limit N` (per playlist), `--force` (reprocess done episodes), `--dry-run`, `--min-fidelity 0.45`, `--llm-review`, `--delay 2.0` (seconds between episodes), `--state-file PATH`.
302	
303	**Resume is automatic**: state is checkpointed to `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` after every episode; re-runs skip `ingested`/`quarantined` episodes and retry `failed`/`no_transcript` ones.
304	
305	**Fidelity review** (`lib/transcript_fidelity.py`) scores each transcript 0–1 from coverage, speech density (wpm), caption gaps, artifact ratio, and repetition; verdicts: `pass` ≥ 0.7, `review` ≥ 0.45, `fail` < 0.45. Failing/below-threshold episodes are **quarantined** (transcript + fidelity JSON kept on disk, not ingested). Artifacts: cleaned transcripts in `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/`, per-episode fidelity reports and per-run markdown summaries in `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/`.
306	
307	See [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) for stage internals, state schema, quarantine review workflow, and tuning.
308	
309	## Content Type Detection
310	
311	YouTube: URL contains `youtube.com` or `youtu.be`. Web: starts with `http(s)://`. File: everything else (validated with `os.path.exists`).
312	
313	## Extending the Pipeline
314	
315	Add stages in `process_url()` or `process_file()` following this pattern:
316	
317	```python
318	if result and result.get('doc_id'):
319	    try:
320	        processing_steps.append("New stage")
321	        # ... processing logic ...
322	    except Exception as e:
323	        logger.warning(f"New stage skipped: {e}")
324	```
325	
326	## File Relocation
327	
328	Processed files from `data/processing_queue/` auto-move to `packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/`.
329	
330	## Troubleshooting
331	
332	- **Module not found**: Activate `.venv`, run `pip install -r requirements.txt`
333	- **API key errors**: Source `.env` or export `OPENAI_API_KEY` manually
334	- **CocoIndex unavailable**: `pip install cocoindex` + configure PostgreSQL/Neo4j
335	- **Mem0 disabled**: Set `MEM0_API_KEY` env var
336	- **Upstash sync skipped**: Set `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL` + `UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`
337	
338	## References
339

341	- [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) -- playlist pipeline stages, fidelity scoring, state/resume, quarantine workflow

137	## Triple RAG Architecture
138	
139	The system uses three vector backends with weighted scoring:
140	
141	| Backend | Weight | Package | Purpose |
142	|---------|--------|---------|---------|
143	| Upstash Vector | 40% | lib/upstash/vector.py | Cloud vector search |
144	| FAISS (LocalRAG) | 40% | vector_storage/ | Local vector indices |
145	| CocoIndex PostgreSQL | 20% | lib/cocoindex_integration.py | Knowledge graph analytics |
146	
147	Orchestrated by `lib/unified_rag_orchestrator.py`.
148	
149	## Entity Extraction System
150	
151	Located in `lib/entity_extraction/`:
152	
153	- **Schemas**: Define entity types (personnel, organizations, locations, events, technologies, documents)
154	- **Processors**: `interactive_entity_processor.py` -- extracts entities and matches against 230,998+ Xata database records
155	- **Tools**: Utilities for entity normalization, deduplication
156	- **85-95% extraction accuracy** on UAP research content
157	
158	Key function:
159	```python
160	from lib.entity_extraction.processors.interactive_entity_processor import process_summary_file_interactive
161	results = process_summary_file_interactive(summary_path, doc_id, interactive=False)
162	# Returns: { total_entities, total_matches, entities: [...], status }
163	```
164

166	
167	```python
168	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD

171	# Core operations

173	doc = kb.get_document(doc_id)

 `./apps/disclosure-rag/disclosure-rag-processor/references/playlist-ingestion.md`

```text
1	# Playlist Ingestion Reference
2	
3	Deep-dive on the YouTube podcast playlist pipeline (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`).
4	
5	## Stage-by-Stage Flow
6	
7	```
8	playlist URL(s)
9	  |-> Episode Enumeration
10	  |     yt-dlp flat extraction (no downloads; returns id, title, duration per entry)
11	  |     pytube fallback if yt-dlp fails
12	  |     Plain video URLs are treated as single-episode playlists
13	  |
14	  |-> Transcript Fetch (per episode)
15	  |     lib/youtube_transcript_enhanced.get_metadata_and_transcript_api_first()
16	  |     Cookie-free youtube-transcript-api + oEmbed metadata
17	  |     No transcript available -> status `no_transcript`, move on
18	  |
19	  |-> Parse + Clean
20	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.clean_transcript()
21	  |     Strips [Music]/[Applause]/[inaudible] cues, dedupes stuck caption
22	  |     lines, normalizes whitespace
23	  |     Cleaned copy saved to data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<video_id>.txt
24	  |
25	  |-> Fidelity Review
26	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.review_transcript() -> FidelityReport
27	  |     Heuristic subscores (weights):
28	  |       coverage   .30  captions cover the episode's yt-dlp duration
29	  |       density    .20  words-per-minute in the 90-220 speech band
30	  |       gaps       .15  largest silence between caption segments
31	  |       artifacts  .15  non-speech cue ratio in raw text
32	  |       repetition .20  duplicate 6-gram windows (stuck captions)
33	  |     Optional --llm-review: samples 3 chunks, asks FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL
34	  |     (default gpt-5.5) for a coherence rating that becomes 1/3 of the score
35	  |     Verdicts: pass >= 0.7 | review 0.45-0.7 | fail < 0.45
36	  |     Report saved to data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<video_id>.fidelity.json
37	  |
38	  |-> Quality Gate
39	  |     verdict `fail` OR score < --min-fidelity -> status `quarantined`
40	  |     (transcript + report kept on disk for human review; NOT ingested)
41	  |
42	  |-> Full Pipeline (main.process_url)
43	        KB storage -> Upstash sync -> NER entity extraction ->
44	        vectorization (--upload -> OpenAI vector store) ->
45	        CocoIndex knowledge graph -> Mem0 memory
46	```
47	
48	## Checkpointing & Resume
49	
50	State lives in `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json`, keyed by video ID:
51	
52	```json
53	{
54	  "videos": {
55	    "dQw4w9WgXcQ": {
56	      "title": "...", "url": "...", "playlist_id": "PL...",
57	      "status": "ingested", "fidelity": 0.87, "doc_id": "abc123",
58	      "updated": "2026-07-23T18:00:00+00:00"
59	    }
60	  }
61	}
62	```
63	
64	- State is written after **every** episode (atomic tmp-file swap), so a crash
65	  or Ctrl-C loses at most the in-flight episode.
66	- Re-running the same playlist skips episodes whose status is `ingested` or
67	  `quarantined`. `no_transcript` and `failed` episodes are retried
68	  automatically. Use `--force` to reprocess everything.
69	- Statuses: `ingested`, `quarantined`, `no_transcript`, `failed`, `dry_run`,
70	  `skipped` (counted per run, not stored).
71	
72	## Output Artifacts
73	
74	| Path | Contents |
75	|------|----------|
76	| `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` | Resume checkpoint (all episodes ever seen) |
77	| `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<id>.txt` | Cleaned transcript (title + URL header) |
78	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<id>.fidelity.json` | Full FidelityReport with subscores + issues |
79	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/run-<ts>.md` | Per-run markdown summary table |
80	
81	## Duplicate Fetch Note
82	
83	The fidelity stage fetches the transcript once for scoring, then
84	`main.process_url()` re-fetches it internally during ingestion. This is
85	deliberate: it keeps `main.py` untouched and the gate fully decoupled. The
86	transcript API is fast and the `--delay` flag (default 2s) keeps request
87	pacing polite. If YouTube rate-limits a long run, raise `--delay`.
88	
89	## Reviewing Quarantined Episodes
90	
91	```bash
92	# List quarantined episodes with their issues
93	python -c "
94	import json
95	s = json.load(open('data/playlist_ingestion/state.json'))
96	for vid, e in s['videos'].items():
97	    if e.get('status') == 'quarantined':
98	        print(f\"{vid}  {e.get('fidelity')}  {e['title'][:60]}\")
99	        for i in e.get('issues', []): print(f'   - {i}')
100	"
101	```
102	
103	To ingest one anyway after manual review, run the standard single-URL path:
104	
105	```bash
106	python main.py "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>" --upload
107	```
108	
109	then update its state entry (or just leave it — `--force` is per-run, and the
110	single-URL path doesn't consult the playlist state file).
111	
112	## Tuning
113	
114	- `--min-fidelity 0.6` — stricter gate for noisy auto-captioned channels
115	- `--llm-review` — worth it for channels with heavy crosstalk; costs one
116	  chat completion per episode (`FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL`, default `gpt-5.5`)
117	- `--limit 5 --dry-run` — cheap preview of a new playlist's caption quality
118	  before committing to a full ingest
119	- Fidelity weights/thresholds live at the top of `lib/transcript_fidelity.py`
120
```
</details></tool-use>

3	description: >

5	  Use when ingesting web articles, YouTube videos, or local documents into the knowledge base,

12	---
13	
14	# Disclosure RAG Processor
15	
16	Process UFO/UAP research content through a multi-stage pipeline: content extraction, knowledge base storage, entity extraction, knowledge graph construction, and contextual memory.
17	
18	## Working Directory
19	
20	All commands run from `apps/disclosure-rag/`. Activate venv and load env first:
21	
22	```bash
23	cd apps/disclosure-rag && source .venv/bin/activate && source .env
24	```
25	
26	Required: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `UFO_DATA_STORE_ID`. Optional: `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL`/`UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`, `MEM0_API_KEY`, `MEM0_USER_ID`.
27	
28	## CLI Entry Points
29	
30	### main.py -- Primary Processor
31	
32	```bash
33	python main.py <URL_OR_FILE> [--upload] [--no-kb] [--status]
34	```
35	
36	Auto-detects content type (YouTube / web / file). `--upload` sends to OpenAI vector store. `--status` shows all integration backends.
37	
38	### main.sh -- Shell Wrapper
39	
40	```bash
41	./main.sh process-url <URL> [--upload]    # Single URL
42	./main.sh process-file <FILE> [--upload]  # Single file
43	./main.sh process-urls <URL_FILE>         # Batch from file
44	./main.sh search "Phoenix Lights"         # Search KB
45	./main.sh stats                           # KB statistics
46	./main.sh ui                              # Streamlit (port 8501)
47	./main.sh chat                            # Chat interface
48	./main.sh setup                           # Install dependencies
49	./main.sh sync-rag                        # Sync to local RAG
50	```
51	
52	Auto-creates `.venv` if missing, loads `.env`, validates env vars.
53	
54	### cli.py -- Interactive TUI (use for bulk ingestion & research chat)
55	
56	```bash
57	python cli.py
58	```
59	
60	Menu: **Search KB** | **Bulk Ingestion** (folder → all PDFs/DOCX/TXT/MD) | **Research Chat** | **Entity Analysis** | **Geospatial Analysis** | **Reports**. Uses Charm tools (gum/glow/glamour); falls back to plain input if not installed.
61	
62	### run.sh -- Alternative Runner
63	
64	```bash
65	./run.sh chat | agno-chat | agno-chat-files
66	./run.sh process-url --url <URL> --upload
67	./run.sh process-yt --url <YT_URL> --upload
68	./run.sh test | lint | format | clean
69	```
70	
71	## Processing Pipeline
72	
73	```
74	Input (URL/YouTube/File)
75	  |-> Content Extraction
76	  |     YouTube: lib/youtube.py transcript extraction
77	  |     Web: processing/web_content_processor.py scraping
78	  |     File: direct read (supports .md, .pdf, .txt — NOT .docx; use bulk ingestion for docx)
79	  |
80	  |-> Knowledge Base Storage (lib/knowledge_base_crud.py)
81	  |     Indexes content, assigns doc_id
82	  |
83	  |-> Upstash Search Sync (lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py)
84	  |     Syncs to frontend search index (if configured)
85	  |
86	  |-> Entity Extraction (lib/entity_extraction/)
87	  |     NER + Xata database matching (85-95% accuracy)
88	  |     Extracts: personnel, organizations, locations, events
89	  |
90	  |-> CocoIndex Knowledge Graph (lib/cocoindex_integration.py)
91	  |     Builds entity relationships (requires PostgreSQL + Neo4j)
92	  |
93	  |-> Mem0 Contextual Memory (lib/mem0_integration.py)
94	  |     Stores processing summaries, entity memories
95	  |
96	  |-> Upstash Queue (lib/upstash/queue.py)
97	       QStash async processing for downstream consumers
98	```
99	
100	Each stage is fault-tolerant -- failures log warnings but never block the pipeline.
101	
102	## Key Modules
103	
104	| Module | Purpose |
105	|--------|---------|
106	| `lib/knowledge_base_service.py` | Orchestrates KB indexing + Upstash sync |
107	| `lib/knowledge_base_crud.py` | Full CRUD -- see API section below |
108	| `lib/terminal_display.py` | Animated spinners, styled headers, progress output |
109	| `lib/entity_extraction/processors/interactive_entity_processor.py` | NER with `process_summary_file_interactive()` |
110	| `lib/cocoindex_integration.py` | `cocoindex_processor.process_document_knowledge_graph()` |
111	| `lib/mem0_integration.py` | Memory functions -- see API section below |
112	| `lib/unified_rag_orchestrator.py` | `UnifiedRAGOrchestrator` -- async multi-backend search |
113	| `processing/web_content_processor.py` | `WebContentProcessor` for web scraping |
114	| `processing/content_analysis.py` | Content classification and topic detection |
115	| `scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py` | `BulkFolderIngestion` -- multi-format batch processing |
116	| `agents/` | 14 specialized research agents (see Agents section) |
117	| `api_server.py` | FastAPI REST server with RAG search endpoints |
118	
119	## KnowledgeBaseCRUD Full API
120	
121	```python
122	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD
123	kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()
124	
125	kb.create_document(title, content, source, doc_type, metadata, tags)  # returns Document
126	kb.get_document(doc_id)              # returns Optional[Document]
127	kb.list_documents(doc_type, tags, limit, offset)  # returns List[Document]
128	kb.search_documents(query, limit)    # returns List[Dict] with score/snippet
129	kb.update_document(doc_id, title, content, metadata, tags)
130	kb.delete_document(doc_id)          # returns bool
131	kb.bulk_import(directory, doc_type)  # returns List[Document]
132	kb.export_document(doc_id, output_dir)
133	kb.get_statistics()                  # returns {total_documents, total_tags, documents_by_type, popular_tags, last_updated}
134	```
135	
136	`doc_type` values: `'case_file'`, `'transcript'`, `'article'`, `'research'`
137	
138	Storage paths: transcripts → `sources/transcripts/`, articles → `sources/web/`, files → `sources/files/`, research → `research/`
139	
140	## Mem0 Full API
141	
142	```python
143	from lib.mem0_integration import (
144	    add_memory(messages, user_id, agent_id, metadata)     # core add
145	    search_memories(query, user_id, limit)                # semantic search
146	    add_youtube_summary_memory(title, video_url, video_id, summary, tags)
147	    add_web_article_memory(title, url, content, summary, tags)
148	    add_file_content_memory(title, file_path, content, file_type, tags)
149	    add_entity_extraction_memory(doc_id, entities, total_matches, processing_results)
150	    add_knowledge_graph_memory(doc_id, entities_processed, relationships_processed, kg_results)
151	    add_processing_summary_memory(doc_id, title, content_type, processing_steps, final_status)
152	    contextual_add(user_id, text, metadata)               # direct contextual storage
153	    search_context(user_id, query, top_k)                 # retrieve context
154	)
155	```
156	
157	Env: `MEM0_API_KEY` or `NEXT_PUBLIC_MEM0_API_KEY`. Disable with `MEM0_ENABLE=false`. Agent ID: `MEM0_AGENT_ID` (default: `disclosure-rag-agent`).
158	
159	## Entity Extraction -- Entity Types
160	
161	9 entity types extracted from UAP content:
162	
163	| Type | Key Fields |
164	|------|-----------|
165	| `PERSON` | role, credibility(1-10), authority(1-10), bio |
166	| `EVENT` | title, datetime, location(coordinates), metadata |
167	| `ORGANIZATION` | title, specialization, image |

171	| `DOCUMENT` | embedding(1536d), url, file[] |
172	| `ARTIFACT` | name, origin, images |
173	| `SIGHTING` | shape, duration_seconds, media_link, location |
174	
175	Confidence levels: High (0.9-1.0) → direct DB insert, Medium (0.6-0.8) → flag for review, Low (0.3-0.5) → archive.

231	## Unified RAG Search
232	
233	```python
234	from lib.unified_rag_orchestrator import UnifiedRAGOrchestrator
235	import asyncio
236	
237	rag = UnifiedRAGOrchestrator(openai_api_key, vector_store_id)

239	    query="Phoenix Lights",
240	    max_results=10,
241	    system_preference='auto'  # 'auto', 'openai', 'local'
242	))
243	status = rag.get_system_status()   # { openai: RAGSystemStatus, local: RAGSystemStatus }
244	```
245	
246	## Bulk Ingestion (`scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py`)
247	
248	Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD files. Extracts text, creates triple-RAG documents.
249	
250	**CLI entry point — choose one:**
251	
252	```bash
253	# Option A: Interactive TUI (recommended for first use)
254	python cli.py
255	# → Select "Bulk Ingestion" from menu → enter folder path when prompted
256	
257	# Option B: Run script directly (non-interactive)
258	python scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py
259	# Note: no built-in CLI flags — configure folder_path in the script or use Option C
260	
261	# Option C: Python one-liner
262	python -c "
263	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
264	b = BulkFolderIngestion('/path/to/folder')
265	docs = b.discover_documents()
266	print(f'Found {len(docs)} files')
267	for d in docs: b.create_triple_rag_document(d, b.extract_text_content(d))
268	"
269	```
270	
271	**Python API:**
272	
273	```python
274	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
275	
276	ingestion = BulkFolderIngestion(folder_path, output_dir="ingestion_results")
277	docs = ingestion.discover_documents()           # find all supported files
278	for doc in docs:
279	    text = ingestion.extract_text_content(doc)  # PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD
280	    rag_doc = ingestion.create_triple_rag_document(doc, text)
281	```
282	
283	## Playlist Ingestion (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`)
284	
285	Batch-ingest one or more YouTube podcast playlists end-to-end. Each episode flows through: enumeration → transcript fetch → parse/clean → **fidelity review** (quality gate) → full pipeline (KB storage, NER entity extraction, vectorization, CocoIndex knowledge graph, Mem0).
286	
287	```bash
288	# One or more playlist URLs (plain video URLs also accepted)
289	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL..." [MORE_URLS...]
290	
291	# From a file (one URL per line, # comments allowed), with vector store upload
292	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py --from-file playlists.txt --upload
293	
294	# Preview a new playlist's caption quality without ingesting
295	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --limit 5 --dry-run
296	
297	# Stricter gate + LLM coherence pass (FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL, default gpt-5.5)
298	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --min-fidelity 0.6 --llm-review
299	```
300	
301	Flags: `--upload` (OpenAI vector store), `--no-kb`, `--limit N` (per playlist), `--force` (reprocess done episodes), `--dry-run`, `--min-fidelity 0.45`, `--llm-review`, `--delay 2.0` (seconds between episodes), `--state-file PATH`.
302	
303	**Resume is automatic**: state is checkpointed to `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` after every episode; re-runs skip `ingested`/`quarantined` episodes and retry `failed`/`no_transcript` ones.
304	
305	**Fidelity review** (`lib/transcript_fidelity.py`) scores each transcript 0–1 from coverage, speech density (wpm), caption gaps, artifact ratio, and repetition; verdicts: `pass` ≥ 0.7, `review` ≥ 0.45, `fail` < 0.45. Failing/below-threshold episodes are **quarantined** (transcript + fidelity JSON kept on disk, not ingested). Artifacts: cleaned transcripts in `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/`, per-episode fidelity reports and per-run markdown summaries in `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/`.
306	
307	See [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) for stage internals, state schema, quarantine review workflow, and tuning.
308	
309	## Content Type Detection
310	
311	YouTube: URL contains `youtube.com` or `youtu.be`. Web: starts with `http(s)://`. File: everything else (validated with `os.path.exists`).
312	
313	## Extending the Pipeline
314	
315	Add stages in `process_url()` or `process_file()` following this pattern:
316	
317	```python

319	    try:
320	        processing_steps.append("New stage")
321	        # ... processing logic ...
322	    except Exception as e:
323	        logger.warning(f"New stage skipped: {e}")
324	```
325	
326	## File Relocation
327	
328	Processed files from `data/processing_queue/` auto-move to `packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/`.
329	
330	## Troubleshooting
331	
332	- **Module not found**: Activate `.venv`, run `pip install -r requirements.txt`
333	- **API key errors**: Source `.env` or export `OPENAI_API_KEY` manually
334	- **CocoIndex unavailable**: `pip install cocoindex` + configure PostgreSQL/Neo4j
335	- **Mem0 disabled**: Set `MEM0_API_KEY` env var
336	- **Upstash sync skipped**: Set `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL` + `UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`
337

341	- [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) -- playlist pipeline stages, fidelity scoring, state/resume, quarantine workflow

13	
14	# Disclosure RAG Processor
15	
16	Process UFO/UAP research content through a multi-stage pipeline: content extraction, knowledge base storage, entity extraction, knowledge graph construction, and contextual memory.
17	
18	## Working Directory
19	
20	All commands run from `apps/disclosure-rag/`. Activate venv and load env first:
21	
22	```bash
23	cd apps/disclosure-rag && source .venv/bin/activate && source .env
24	```
25	
26	Required: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `UFO_DATA_STORE_ID`. Optional: `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL`/`UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`, `MEM0_API_KEY`, `MEM0_USER_ID`.
27	
28	## CLI Entry Points
29	
30	### main.py -- Primary Processor
31	
32	```bash
33	python main.py <URL_OR_FILE> [--upload] [--no-kb] [--status]
34	```
35	
36	Auto-detects content type (YouTube / web / file). `--upload` sends to OpenAI vector store. `--status` shows all integration backends.
37	
38	### main.sh -- Shell Wrapper
39	
40	```bash
41	./main.sh process-url <URL> [--upload]    # Single URL
42	./main.sh process-file <FILE> [--upload]  # Single file
43	./main.sh process-urls <URL_FILE>         # Batch from file
44	./main.sh search "Phoenix Lights"         # Search KB
45	./main.sh stats                           # KB statistics
46	./main.sh ui                              # Streamlit (port 8501)
47	./main.sh chat                            # Chat interface
48	./main.sh setup                           # Install dependencies
49	./main.sh sync-rag                        # Sync to local RAG
50	```
51	
52	Auto-creates `.venv` if missing, loads `.env`, validates env vars.
53	
54	### cli.py -- Interactive TUI (use for bulk ingestion & research chat)
55	
56	```bash
57	python cli.py
58	```
59	
60	Menu: **Search KB** | **Bulk Ingestion** (folder → all PDFs/DOCX/TXT/MD) | **Research Chat** | **Entity Analysis** | **Geospatial Analysis** | **Reports**. Uses Charm tools (gum/glow/glamour); falls back to plain input if not installed.
61	
62	### run.sh -- Alternative Runner
63	
64	```bash
65	./run.sh chat | agno-chat | agno-chat-files

67	./run.sh process-yt --url <YT_URL> --upload

71	## Processing Pipeline
72	
73	```
74	Input (URL/YouTube/File)
75	  |-> Content Extraction
76	  |     YouTube: lib/youtube.py transcript extraction
77	  |     Web: processing/web_content_processor.py scraping
78	  |     File: direct read (supports .md, .pdf, .txt — NOT .docx; use bulk ingestion for docx)
79	  |
80	  |-> Knowledge Base Storage (lib/knowledge_base_crud.py)
81	  |     Indexes content, assigns doc_id
82	  |
83	  |-> Upstash Search Sync (lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py)
84	  |     Syncs to frontend search index (if configured)
85	  |
86	  |-> Entity Extraction (lib/entity_extraction/)
87	  |     NER + Xata database matching (85-95% accuracy)
88	  |     Extracts: personnel, organizations, locations, events
89	  |
90	  |-> CocoIndex Knowledge Graph (lib/cocoindex_integration.py)
91	  |     Builds entity relationships (requires PostgreSQL + Neo4j)
92	  |
93	  |-> Mem0 Contextual Memory (lib/mem0_integration.py)
94	  |     Stores processing summaries, entity memories
95	  |
96	  |-> Upstash Queue (lib/upstash/queue.py)
97	       QStash async processing for downstream consumers
98	```
99	
100	Each stage is fault-tolerant -- failures log warnings but never block the pipeline.
101

119	## KnowledgeBaseCRUD Full API
120	
121	```python
122	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD
123	kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()
124	
125	kb.create_document(title, content, source, doc_type, metadata, tags)  # returns Document
126	kb.get_document(doc_id)              # returns Optional[Document]
127	kb.list_documents(doc_type, tags, limit, offset)  # returns List[Document]
128	kb.search_documents(query, limit)    # returns List[Dict] with score/snippet
129	kb.update_document(doc_id, title, content, metadata, tags)
130	kb.delete_document(doc_id)          # returns bool
131	kb.bulk_import(directory, doc_type)  # returns List[Document]
132	kb.export_document(doc_id, output_dir)
133	kb.get_statistics()                  # returns {total_documents, total_tags, documents_by_type, popular_tags, last_updated}
134	```
135	
136	`doc_type` values: `'case_file'`, `'transcript'`, `'article'`, `'research'`
137	
138	Storage paths: transcripts → `sources/transcripts/`, articles → `sources/web/`, files → `sources/files/`, research → `research/`

159	## Entity Extraction -- Entity Types
160	
161	9 entity types extracted from UAP content:
162	
163	| Type | Key Fields |
164	|------|-----------|
165	| `PERSON` | role, credibility(1-10), authority(1-10), bio |
166	| `EVENT` | title, datetime, location(coordinates), metadata |
167	| `ORGANIZATION` | title, specialization, image |
168	| `LOCATION` | coordinates, google_maps_id, city/state |
169	| `TESTIMONY` | claim, source, documentation[] |
170	| `TOPIC` | title, summary, photos |
171	| `DOCUMENT` | embedding(1536d), url, file[] |
172	| `ARTIFACT` | name, origin, images |
173	| `SIGHTING` | shape, duration_seconds, media_link, location |
174	
175	Confidence levels: High (0.9-1.0) → direct DB insert, Medium (0.6-0.8) → flag for review, Low (0.3-0.5) → archive.

181	    video_id,            # doc_id to associate
182	    interactive=False    # True for human review mode
183	)
184	# returns: { total_entities, total_matches, entities, status }

246	## Bulk Ingestion (`scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py`)
247	
248	Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD files. Extracts text, creates triple-RAG documents.
249	
250	**CLI entry point — choose one:**
251	
252	```bash
253	# Option A: Interactive TUI (recommended for first use)
254	python cli.py
255	# → Select "Bulk Ingestion" from menu → enter folder path when prompted
256	
257	# Option B: Run script directly (non-interactive)
258	python scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py
259	# Note: no built-in CLI flags — configure folder_path in the script or use Option C
260	
261	# Option C: Python one-liner
262	python -c "
263	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
264	b = BulkFolderIngestion('/path/to/folder')
265	docs = b.discover_documents()
266	print(f'Found {len(docs)} files')
267	for d in docs: b.create_triple_rag_document(d, b.extract_text_content(d))
268	"
269	```
270	
271	**Python API:**
272	
273	```python
274	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
275	
276	ingestion = BulkFolderIngestion(folder_path, output_dir="ingestion_results")
277	docs = ingestion.discover_documents()           # find all supported files
278	for doc in docs:
279	    text = ingestion.extract_text_content(doc)  # PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD
280	    rag_doc = ingestion.create_triple_rag_document(doc, text)
281	```
282	
283	## Playlist Ingestion (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`)
284	
285	Batch-ingest one or more YouTube podcast playlists end-to-end. Each episode flows through: enumeration → transcript fetch → parse/clean → **fidelity review** (quality gate) → full pipeline (KB storage, NER entity extraction, vectorization, CocoIndex knowledge graph, Mem0).
286	
287	```bash
288	# One or more playlist URLs (plain video URLs also accepted)
289	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL..." [MORE_URLS...]
290	
291	# From a file (one URL per line, # comments allowed), with vector store upload
292	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py --from-file playlists.txt --upload
293	
294	# Preview a new playlist's caption quality without ingesting
295	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --limit 5 --dry-run
296	
297	# Stricter gate + LLM coherence pass (FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL, default gpt-5.5)
298	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --min-fidelity 0.6 --llm-review
299	```
300	
301	Flags: `--upload` (OpenAI vector store), `--no-kb`, `--limit N` (per playlist), `--force` (reprocess done episodes), `--dry-run`, `--min-fidelity 0.45`, `--llm-review`, `--delay 2.0` (seconds between episodes), `--state-file PATH`.
302	
303	**Resume is automatic**: state is checkpointed to `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` after every episode; re-runs skip `ingested`/`quarantined` episodes and retry `failed`/`no_transcript` ones.
304	
305	**Fidelity review** (`lib/transcript_fidelity.py`) scores each transcript 0–1 from coverage, speech density (wpm), caption gaps, artifact ratio, and repetition; verdicts: `pass` ≥ 0.7, `review` ≥ 0.45, `fail` < 0.45. Failing/below-threshold episodes are **quarantined** (transcript + fidelity JSON kept on disk, not ingested). Artifacts: cleaned transcripts in `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/`, per-episode fidelity reports and per-run markdown summaries in `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/`.
306	
307	See [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) for stage internals, state schema, quarantine review workflow, and tuning.
308	
309	## Content Type Detection
310	
311	YouTube: URL contains `youtube.com` or `youtu.be`. Web: starts with `http(s)://`. File: everything else (validated with `os.path.exists`).
312

316	
317	```python

324	```

326	## File Relocation
327	
328	Processed files from `data/processing_queue/` auto-move to `packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/`.
329	
330	## Troubleshooting
331	
332	- **Module not found**: Activate `.venv`, run `pip install -r requirements.txt`
333	- **API key errors**: Source `.env` or export `OPENAI_API_KEY` manually
334	- **CocoIndex unavailable**: `pip install cocoindex` + configure PostgreSQL/Neo4j
335	- **Mem0 disabled**: Set `MEM0_API_KEY` env var
336	- **Upstash sync skipped**: Set `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL` + `UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`
337

78	## Data Flow Details
79	
80	### YouTube Processing Path
81	
82	```
83	URL -> is_youtube_url() check
84	  -> process_youtube_url_enhanced() [lib/knowledge_base_service.py]
85	    -> YouTube transcript extraction [lib/youtube.py]
86	    -> Content analysis + summarization
87	    -> add_youtube_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
88	    -> Upstash Search sync (IntegratedUpstashSyncer)
89	  -> Mem0: add_web_article_memory() [skipped for YT, handled in transcript]
90	  -> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
91	  -> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
92	```
93	
94	### Web URL Processing Path
95	
96	```
97	URL -> process_web_url_enhanced() [lib/knowledge_base_service.py]
98	  -> WebContentProcessor.process() [processing/web_content_processor.py]
99	  -> Content analysis + classification
100	  -> add_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
101	  -> Upstash Search sync
102	-> Mem0: add_web_article_memory(title, url, content, summary, tags)
103	-> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
104	-> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
105	```
106	
107	### File Processing Path
108	
109	```
110	File -> process_file() [main.py]
111	  -> Read file content
112	  -> Extract title from filename or markdown header
113	  -> OpenAI upload (if --upload)
114	  -> Upstash queue (add_processed_content_to_queue)
115	  -> add_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
116	  -> Mem0: add_file_content_memory()
117	  -> Entity extraction: process_summary_file_interactive(path, doc_id, interactive=False)
118	  -> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
119	  -> File relocation: processing_queue/ -> packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/
120	  -> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
121	```

123	## Integration Status Check
124	
125	`python main.py --status` reports on:
126	
127	| Backend | Check |
128	|---------|-------|
129	| Local KB | KnowledgeBaseCRUD initialized |
130	| Search Sync | IntegratedUpstashSyncer available |
131	| Search URL | UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL env var set |
132	| Search Token | UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN env var set |
133	| CocoIndex KG | cocoindex module importable |
134	| KG Statistics | Documents, entities, relationships counts |
135	| Mem0 | MEM0_API_KEY set and module available |
136	
137	## Triple RAG Architecture
138	
139	The system uses three vector backends with weighted scoring:
140	
141	| Backend | Weight | Package | Purpose |
142	|---------|--------|---------|---------|
143	| Upstash Vector | 40% | lib/upstash/vector.py | Cloud vector search |
144	| FAISS (LocalRAG) | 40% | vector_storage/ | Local vector indices |
145	| CocoIndex PostgreSQL | 20% | lib/cocoindex_integration.py | Knowledge graph analytics |
146	
147	Orchestrated by `lib/unified_rag_orchestrator.py`.
148	
149	## Entity Extraction System
150	
151	Located in `lib/entity_extraction/`:
152	
153	- **Schemas**: Define entity types (personnel, organizations, locations, events, technologies, documents)
154	- **Processors**: `interactive_entity_processor.py` -- extracts entities and matches against 230,998+ Xata database records
155	- **Tools**: Utilities for entity normalization, deduplication
156	- **85-95% extraction accuracy** on UAP research content
157	
158	Key function:
159	```python
160	from lib.entity_extraction.processors.interactive_entity_processor import process_summary_file_interactive
161	results = process_summary_file_interactive(summary_path, doc_id, interactive=False)
162	# Returns: { total_entities, total_matches, entities: [...], status }
163	```
164	
165	## Knowledge Base CRUD API
166	
167	```python
168	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD
169	kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()
170	
171	# Core operations
172	doc_id = kb.add_document(data, doc_type)    # doc_type: 'research', 'case_file', etc.
173	doc = kb.get_document(doc_id)
174	results = kb.search_documents(query)         # Returns: [{ title, score, doc_type, snippet }]
175	stats = kb.get_statistics()                  # Returns: { total_documents, total_tags, documents_by_type, popular_tags, last_updated }
176	```
177	
178	## Mem0 Memory Functions
179	
180	```python
181	from lib.mem0_integration import (
182	    add_web_article_memory,          # title, url, content, summary, tags
183	    add_file_content_memory,         # title, file_path, content, file_type, tags
184	    add_entity_extraction_memory,    # doc_id, entities, total_matches, processing_results
185	    add_knowledge_graph_memory,      # doc_id, entities_processed, relationships_processed, kg_results
186	    add_processing_summary_memory,   # doc_id, title, content_type, processing_steps, final_status
187	    _is_enabled,                     # Check if Mem0 is active
188	    _get_api_key,                    # Get configured API key
189	)
190	```
191	
192	## Bulk Ingestion
193	
194	```python
195	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
196	ingester = BulkFolderIngestion()
197	ingester.process_folder("/path/to/folder")
198	```
199	
200	Also accessible via `cli.py` interactive menu under "Bulk Document Ingestion".
201
```
</details></tool-use>

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `./apps/disclosure-rag/disclosure-rag-processor/references/playlist-ingestion.md`

```text
1	# Playlist Ingestion Reference
2	
3	Deep-dive on the YouTube podcast playlist pipeline (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`).
4	
5	## Stage-by-Stage Flow
6	
7	```
8	playlist URL(s)
9	  |-> Episode Enumeration
10	  |     yt-dlp flat extraction (no downloads; returns id, title, duration per entry)
11	  |     pytube fallback if yt-dlp fails
12	  |     Plain video URLs are treated as single-episode playlists
13	  |
14	  |-> Transcript Fetch (per episode)
15	  |     lib/youtube_transcript_enhanced.get_metadata_and_transcript_api_first()
16	  |     Cookie-free youtube-transcript-api + oEmbed metadata
17	  |     No transcript available -> status `no_transcript`, move on
18	  |
19	  |-> Parse + Clean
20	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.clean_transcript()
21	  |     Strips [Music]/[Applause]/[inaudible] cues, dedupes stuck caption
22	  |     lines, normalizes whitespace
23	  |     Cleaned copy saved to data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<video_id>.txt
24	  |
25	  |-> Fidelity Review
26	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.review_transcript() -> FidelityReport
27	  |     Heuristic subscores (weights):
28	  |       coverage   .30  captions cover the episode's yt-dlp duration
29	  |       density    .20  words-per-minute in the 90-220 speech band
30	  |       gaps       .15  largest silence between caption segments
31	  |       artifacts  .15  non-speech cue ratio in raw text
32	  |       repetition .20  duplicate 6-gram windows (stuck captions)
33	  |     Optional --llm-review: samples 3 chunks, asks FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL
34	  |     (default gpt-5.5) for a coherence rating that becomes 1/3 of the score
35	  |     Verdicts: pass >= 0.7 | review 0.45-0.7 | fail < 0.45
36	  |     Report saved to data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<video_id>.fidelity.json
37	  |
38	  |-> Quality Gate
39	  |     verdict `fail` OR score < --min-fidelity -> status `quarantined`
40	  |     (transcript + report kept on disk for human review; NOT ingested)
41	  |
42	  |-> Full Pipeline (main.process_url)
43	        KB storage -> Upstash sync -> NER entity extraction ->
44	        vectorization (--upload -> OpenAI vector store) ->
45	        CocoIndex knowledge graph -> Mem0 memory
46	```
47	
48	## Checkpointing & Resume
49	
50	State lives in `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json`, keyed by video ID:
51	
52	```json
53	{
54	  "videos": {
55	    "dQw4w9WgXcQ": {
56	      "title": "...", "url": "...", "playlist_id": "PL...",
57	      "status": "ingested", "fidelity": 0.87, "doc_id": "abc123",
58	      "updated": "2026-07-23T18:00:00+00:00"
59	    }
60	  }
61	}
62	```
63	
64	- State is written after **every** episode (atomic tmp-file swap), so a crash
65	  or Ctrl-C loses at most the in-flight episode.
66	- Re-running the same playlist skips episodes whose status is `ingested` or
67	  `quarantined`. `no_transcript` and `failed` episodes are retried
68	  automatically. Use `--force` to reprocess everything.
69	- Statuses: `ingested`, `quarantined`, `no_transcript`, `failed`, `dry_run`,
70	  `skipped` (counted per run, not stored).
71	
72	## Output Artifacts
73	
74	| Path | Contents |
75	|------|----------|
76	| `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` | Resume checkpoint (all episodes ever seen) |
77	| `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<id>.txt` | Cleaned transcript (title + URL header) |
78	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<id>.fidelity.json` | Full FidelityReport with subscores + issues |
79	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/run-<ts>.md` | Per-run markdown summary table |
80	
81	## Duplicate Fetch Note
82	
83	The fidelity stage fetches the transcript once for scoring, then
84	`main.process_url()` re-fetches it internally during ingestion. This is
85	deliberate: it keeps `main.py` untouched and the gate fully decoupled. The
86	transcript API is fast and the `--delay` flag (default 2s) keeps request
87	pacing polite. If YouTube rate-limits a long run, raise `--delay`.
88	
89	## Reviewing Quarantined Episodes
90	
91	```bash
92	# List quarantined episodes with their issues
93	python -c "
94	import json
95	s = json.load(open('data/playlist_ingestion/state.json'))
96	for vid, e in s['videos'].items():
97	    if e.get('status') == 'quarantined':
98	        print(f\"{vid}  {e.get('fidelity')}  {e['title'][:60]}\")
99	        for i in e.get('issues', []): print(f'   - {i}')
100	"
101	```
102	
103	To ingest one anyway after manual review, run the standard single-URL path:
104	
105	```bash
106	python main.py "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>" --upload
107	```
108	
109	then update its state entry (or just leave it — `--force` is per-run, and the
110	single-URL path doesn't consult the playlist state file).
111	
112	## Tuning
113	
114	- `--min-fidelity 0.6` — stricter gate for noisy auto-captioned channels
115	- `--llm-review` — worth it for channels with heavy crosstalk; costs one
116	  chat completion per episode (`FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL`, default `gpt-5.5`)
117	- `--limit 5 --dry-run` — cheap preview of a new playlist's caption quality
118	  before committing to a full ingest
119	- Fidelity weights/thresholds live at the top of `lib/transcript_fidelity.py`
120
```
</details></tool-use>

  2. python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ9qNFMHZ-A4rycgrgOYma6zxF4BZGGPW" --upload
     (full ingest: enumeration -> transcript fetch -> clean -> fidelity gate -> KB storage, Upstash sync, NER, OpenAI vector store upload, CocoIndex KG, Mem0; default --min-fidelity 0.45, --delay 2.0)
  3. python -c "
import json
s = json.load(open('data/playlist_ingestion/state.json'))
for vid, e in s['videos'].items():
    if e.get('status') == 'quarantined':
        print(vid, e.get('fidelity'), e['title'][:60])
"

NOTES: Assumes .venv exists (else ./main.sh setup) and captions exist for most episodes; no-transcript episodes are marked no_transcript and retried on re-run. 77	
78	## Data Flow Details
79	
80	### YouTube Processing Path
81	
82	```
83	URL -> is_youtube_url() check
84	  -> process_youtube_url_enhanced() [lib/knowledge_base_service.py]
85	    -> YouTube transcript extraction [lib/youtube.py]
86	    -> Content analysis + summarization
87	    -> add_youtube_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
88	    -> Upstash Search sync (IntegratedUpstashSyncer)
89	  -> Mem0: add_web_article_memory() [skipped for YT, handled in transcript]
90	  -> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
91	  -> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
92	```
93	
94	### Web URL Processing Path
95	
96	```
97	URL -> process_web_url_enhanced() [lib/knowledge_base_service.py]
98	  -> WebContentProcessor.process() [processing/web_content_processor.py]
99	  -> Content analysis + classification
100	  -> add_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
101	  -> Upstash Search sync
102	-> Mem0: add_web_article_memory(title, url, content, summary, tags)
103	-> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
104	-> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
105	```
106	
107	### File Processing Path
108	
109	```
110	File -> process_file() [main.py]
111	  -> Read file content
112	  -> Extract title from filename or markdown header
113	  -> OpenAI upload (if --upload)
114	  -> Upstash queue (add_processed_content_to_queue)
115	  -> add_to_knowledge_base() -> doc_id
116	  -> Mem0: add_file_content_memory()
117	  -> Entity extraction: process_summary_file_interactive(path, doc_id, interactive=False)
118	  -> CocoIndex: trigger_cocoindex_processing(doc_id)
119	  -> File relocation: processing_queue/ -> packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/
120	  -> Mem0: add_processing_summary_memory()
121	```
122	
123	## Integration Status Check
124	
125	`python main.py --status` reports on:
126	
127	| Backend | Check |
128	|---------|-------|
129	| Local KB | KnowledgeBaseCRUD initialized |
130	| Search Sync | IntegratedUpstashSyncer available |
131	| Search URL | UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL env var set |
132	| Search Token | UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN env var set |
133	| CocoIndex KG | cocoindex module importable |
134	| KG Statistics | Documents, entities, relationships counts |
135	| Mem0 | MEM0_API_KEY set and module available |
136	
137	## Triple RAG Architecture
138	
139	The system uses three vector backends with weighted scoring:
140	
141	| Backend | Weight | Package | Purpose |
142	|---------|--------|---------|---------|

<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `./apps/disclosure-rag/disclosure-rag-processor/references/playlist-ingestion.md`

```text
1	# Playlist Ingestion Reference
2	
3	Deep-dive on the YouTube podcast playlist pipeline (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`).
4	
5	## Stage-by-Stage Flow
6	
7	```
8	playlist URL(s)
9	  |-> Episode Enumeration
10	  |     yt-dlp flat extraction (no downloads; returns id, title, duration per entry)
11	  |     pytube fallback if yt-dlp fails
12	  |     Plain video URLs are treated as single-episode playlists
13	  |
14	  |-> Transcript Fetch (per episode)
15	  |     lib/youtube_transcript_enhanced.get_metadata_and_transcript_api_first()
16	  |     Cookie-free youtube-transcript-api + oEmbed metadata
17	  |     No transcript available -> status `no_transcript`, move on
18	  |
19	  |-> Parse + Clean
20	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.clean_transcript()
21	  |     Strips [Music]/[Applause]/[inaudible] cues, dedupes stuck caption
22	  |     lines, normalizes whitespace
23	  |     Cleaned copy saved to data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<video_id>.txt
24	  |
25	  |-> Fidelity Review
26	  |     lib/transcript_fidelity.review_transcript() -> FidelityReport
27	  |     Heuristic subscores (weights):
28	  |       coverage   .30  captions cover the episode's yt-dlp duration
29	  |       density    .20  words-per-minute in the 90-220 speech band
30	  |       gaps       .15  largest silence between caption segments
31	  |       artifacts  .15  non-speech cue ratio in raw text
32	  |       repetition .20  duplicate 6-gram windows (stuck captions)
33	  |     Optional --llm-review: samples 3 chunks, asks FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL
34	  |     (default gpt-5.5) for a coherence rating that becomes 1/3 of the score
35	  |     Verdicts: pass >= 0.7 | review 0.45-0.7 | fail < 0.45
36	  |     Report saved to data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<video_id>.fidelity.json
37	  |
38	  |-> Quality Gate
39	  |     verdict `fail` OR score < --min-fidelity -> status `quarantined`
40	  |     (transcript + report kept on disk for human review; NOT ingested)
41	  |
42	  |-> Full Pipeline (main.process_url)
43	        KB storage -> Upstash sync -> NER entity extraction ->
44	        vectorization (--upload -> OpenAI vector store) ->
45	        CocoIndex knowledge graph -> Mem0 memory
46	```
47	
48	## Checkpointing & Resume
49	
50	State lives in `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json`, keyed by video ID:
51	
52	```json
53	{
54	  "videos": {
55	    "dQw4w9WgXcQ": {
56	      "title": "...", "url": "...", "playlist_id": "PL...",
57	      "status": "ingested", "fidelity": 0.87, "doc_id": "abc123",
58	      "updated": "2026-07-23T18:00:00+00:00"
59	    }
60	  }
61	}
62	```
63	
64	- State is written after **every** episode (atomic tmp-file swap), so a crash
65	  or Ctrl-C loses at most the in-flight episode.
66	- Re-running the same playlist skips episodes whose status is `ingested` or
67	  `quarantined`. `no_transcript` and `failed` episodes are retried
68	  automatically. Use `--force` to reprocess everything.
69	- Statuses: `ingested`, `quarantined`, `no_transcript`, `failed`, `dry_run`,
70	  `skipped` (counted per run, not stored).
71	
72	## Output Artifacts
73	
74	| Path | Contents |
75	|------|----------|
76	| `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` | Resume checkpoint (all episodes ever seen) |
77	| `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/<id>.txt` | Cleaned transcript (title + URL header) |
78	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/<id>.fidelity.json` | Full FidelityReport with subscores + issues |
79	| `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/run-<ts>.md` | Per-run markdown summary table |
80	
81	## Duplicate Fetch Note
82	
83	The fidelity stage fetches the transcript once for scoring, then
84	`main.process_url()` re-fetches it internally during ingestion. This is
85	deliberate: it keeps `main.py` untouched and the gate fully decoupled. The
86	transcript API is fast and the `--delay` flag (default 2s) keeps request
87	pacing polite. If YouTube rate-limits a long run, raise `--delay`.
88	
89	## Reviewing Quarantined Episodes
90	
91	```bash
92	# List quarantined episodes with their issues
93	python -c "
94	import json
95	s = json.load(open('data/playlist_ingestion/state.json'))
96	for vid, e in s['videos'].items():
97	    if e.get('status') == 'quarantined':
98	        print(f\"{vid}  {e.get('fidelity')}  {e['title'][:60]}\")
99	        for i in e.get('issues', []): print(f'   - {i}')
100	"
101	```
102	
103	To ingest one anyway after manual review, run the standard single-URL path:
104	
105	```bash
106	python main.py "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>" --upload
107	```
108	
109	then update its state entry (or just leave it — `--force` is per-run, and the
110	single-URL path doesn't consult the playlist state file).
111	
112	## Tuning
113	
114	- `--min-fidelity 0.6` — stricter gate for noisy auto-captioned channels
115	- `--llm-review` — worth it for channels with heavy crosstalk; costs one
116	  chat completion per episode (`FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL`, default `gpt-5.5`)
117	- `--limit 5 --dry-run` — cheap preview of a new playlist's caption quality
118	  before committing to a full ingest
119	- Fidelity weights/thresholds live at the top of `lib/transcript_fidelity.py`
120
```
</details></tool-use>

13	
14	# Disclosure RAG Processor
15	
16	Process UFO/UAP research content through a multi-stage pipeline: content extraction, knowledge base storage, entity extraction, knowledge graph construction, and contextual memory.
17	
18	## Working Directory
19	
20	All commands run from `apps/disclosure-rag/`. Activate venv and load env first:
21	
22	```bash
23	cd apps/disclosure-rag && source .venv/bin/activate && source .env
24	```
25	
26	Required: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `UFO_DATA_STORE_ID`. Optional: `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL`/`UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`, `MEM0_API_KEY`, `MEM0_USER_ID`.
27	
28	## CLI Entry Points
29	
30	### main.py -- Primary Processor
31	
32	```bash
33	python main.py <URL_OR_FILE> [--upload] [--no-kb] [--status]
34	```
35	
36	Auto-detects content type (YouTube / web / file). `--upload` sends to OpenAI vector store. `--status` shows all integration backends.
37	
38	### main.sh -- Shell Wrapper
39	
40	```bash
41	./main.sh process-url <URL> [--upload]    # Single URL
42	./main.sh process-file <FILE> [--upload]  # Single file
43	./main.sh process-urls <URL_FILE>         # Batch from file
44	./main.sh search "Phoenix Lights"         # Search KB
45	./main.sh stats                           # KB statistics
46	./main.sh ui                              # Streamlit (port 8501)
47	./main.sh chat                            # Chat interface
48	./main.sh setup                           # Install dependencies
49	./main.sh sync-rag                        # Sync to local RAG
50	```
51	
52	Auto-creates `.venv` if missing, loads `.env`, validates env vars.
53	
54	### cli.py -- Interactive TUI (use for bulk ingestion & research chat)
55	
56	```bash
57	python cli.py
58	```
59	
60	Menu: **Search KB** | **Bulk Ingestion** (folder → all PDFs/DOCX/TXT/MD) | **Research Chat** | **Entity Analysis** | **Geospatial Analysis** | **Reports**. Uses Charm tools (gum/glow/glamour); falls back to plain input if not installed.
61	
62	### run.sh -- Alternative Runner
63	
64	```bash
65	./run.sh chat | agno-chat | agno-chat-files
66	./run.sh process-url --url <URL> --upload
67	./run.sh process-yt --url <YT_URL> --upload
68	./run.sh test | lint | format | clean
69	```
70	
71	## Processing Pipeline
72	
73	```
74	Input (URL/YouTube/File)
75	  |-> Content Extraction
76	  |     YouTube: lib/youtube.py transcript extraction
77	  |     Web: processing/web_content_processor.py scraping
78	  |     File: direct read (supports .md, .pdf, .txt — NOT .docx; use bulk ingestion for docx)
79	  |
80	  |-> Knowledge Base Storage (lib/knowledge_base_crud.py)
81	  |     Indexes content, assigns doc_id
82	  |
83	  |-> Upstash Search Sync (lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py)
84	  |     Syncs to frontend search index (if configured)
85	  |
86	  |-> Entity Extraction (lib/entity_extraction/)
87	  |     NER + Xata database matching (85-95% accuracy)
88	  |     Extracts: personnel, organizations, locations, events
89	  |
90	  |-> CocoIndex Knowledge Graph (lib/cocoindex_integration.py)
91	  |     Builds entity relationships (requires PostgreSQL + Neo4j)
92	  |
93	  |-> Mem0 Contextual Memory (lib/mem0_integration.py)
94	  |     Stores processing summaries, entity memories
95	  |
96	  |-> Upstash Queue (lib/upstash/queue.py)
97	       QStash async processing for downstream consumers
98	```
99	
100	Each stage is fault-tolerant -- failures log warnings but never block the pipeline.
101	
102	## Key Modules
103	
104	| Module | Purpose |
105	|--------|---------|
106	| `lib/knowledge_base_service.py` | Orchestrates KB indexing + Upstash sync |
107	| `lib/knowledge_base_crud.py` | Full CRUD -- see API section below |
108	| `lib/terminal_display.py` | Animated spinners, styled headers, progress output |
109	| `lib/entity_extraction/processors/interactive_entity_processor.py` | NER with `process_summary_file_interactive()` |
110	| `lib/cocoindex_integration.py` | `cocoindex_processor.process_document_knowledge_graph()` |
111	| `lib/mem0_integration.py` | Memory functions -- see API section below |
112	| `lib/unified_rag_orchestrator.py` | `UnifiedRAGOrchestrator` -- async multi-backend search |
113	| `processing/web_content_processor.py` | `WebContentProcessor` for web scraping |
114	| `processing/content_analysis.py` | Content classification and topic detection |
115	| `scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py` | `BulkFolderIngestion` -- multi-format batch processing |
116	| `agents/` | 14 specialized research agents (see Agents section) |
117	| `api_server.py` | FastAPI REST server with RAG search endpoints |
118	
119	## KnowledgeBaseCRUD Full API
120	
121	```python
122	from lib.knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD
123	kb = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()
124	
125	kb.create_document(title, content, source, doc_type, metadata, tags)  # returns Document
126	kb.get_document(doc_id)              # returns Optional[Document]
127	kb.list_documents(doc_type, tags, limit, offset)  # returns List[Document]
128	kb.search_documents(query, limit)    # returns List[Dict] with score/snippet
129	kb.update_document(doc_id, title, content, metadata, tags)
130	kb.delete_document(doc_id)          # returns bool
131	kb.bulk_import(directory, doc_type)  # returns List[Document]
132	kb.export_document(doc_id, output_dir)
133	kb.get_statistics()                  # returns {total_documents, total_tags, documents_by_type, popular_tags, last_updated}
134	```
135	
136	`doc_type` values: `'case_file'`, `'transcript'`, `'article'`, `'research'`
137	
138	Storage paths: transcripts → `sources/transcripts/`, articles → `sources/web/`, files → `sources/files/`, research → `research/`
139	
140	## Mem0 Full API
141	
142	```python
143	from lib.mem0_integration import (
144	    add_memory(messages, user_id, agent_id, metadata)     # core add
145	    search_memories(query, user_id, limit)                # semantic search
146	    add_youtube_summary_memory(title, video_url, video_id, summary, tags)
147	    add_web_article_memory(title, url, content, summary, tags)
148	    add_file_content_memory(title, file_path, content, file_type, tags)
149	    add_entity_extraction_memory(doc_id, entities, total_matches, processing_results)
150	    add_knowledge_graph_memory(doc_id, entities_processed, relationships_processed, kg_results)
151	    add_processing_summary_memory(doc_id, title, content_type, processing_steps, final_status)
152	    contextual_add(user_id, text, metadata)               # direct contextual storage
153	    search_context(user_id, query, top_k)                 # retrieve context
154	)
155	```
156	
157	Env: `MEM0_API_KEY` or `NEXT_PUBLIC_MEM0_API_KEY`. Disable with `MEM0_ENABLE=false`. Agent ID: `MEM0_AGENT_ID` (default: `disclosure-rag-agent`).
158	
159	## Entity Extraction -- Entity Types
160	
161	9 entity types extracted from UAP content:
162	
163	| Type | Key Fields |
164	|------|-----------|
165	| `PERSON` | role, credibility(1-10), authority(1-10), bio |
166	| `EVENT` | title, datetime, location(coordinates), metadata |
167	| `ORGANIZATION` | title, specialization, image |
168	| `LOCATION` | coordinates, google_maps_id, city/state |
169	| `TESTIMONY` | claim, source, documentation[] |
170	| `TOPIC` | title, summary, photos |
171	| `DOCUMENT` | embedding(1536d), url, file[] |
172	| `ARTIFACT` | name, origin, images |
173	| `SIGHTING` | shape, duration_seconds, media_link, location |
174	
175	Confidence levels: High (0.9-1.0) → direct DB insert, Medium (0.6-0.8) → flag for review, Low (0.3-0.5) → archive.
176	
177	```python
178	from lib.entity_extraction.processors.interactive_entity_processor import process_summary_file_interactive
179	results = process_summary_file_interactive(
180	    summary_file_path,   # path to text file
181	    video_id,            # doc_id to associate
182	    interactive=False    # True for human review mode
183	)
184	# returns: { total_entities, total_matches, entities, status }
185	```

246	## Bulk Ingestion (`scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py`)
247	
248	Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD files. Extracts text, creates triple-RAG documents.
249	
250	**CLI entry point — choose one:**
251	
252	```bash
253	# Option A: Interactive TUI (recommended for first use)
254	python cli.py
255	# → Select "Bulk Ingestion" from menu → enter folder path when prompted
256	
257	# Option B: Run script directly (non-interactive)
258	python scripts/bulk_folder_ingestion.py
259	# Note: no built-in CLI flags — configure folder_path in the script or use Option C
260	
261	# Option C: Python one-liner
262	python -c "
263	from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion
264	b = BulkFolderIngestion('/path/to/folder')
265	docs = b.discover_documents()
266	print(f'Found {len(docs)} files')
267	for d in docs: b.create_triple_rag_document(d, b.extract_text_content(d))
268	"

270	
271	**Python API:**
272

275	
276	ingestion = BulkFolderIngestion(folder_path, output_dir="ingestion_results")

281	```
282	
283	## Playlist Ingestion (`scripts/playlist_ingestion.py`)
284	
285	Batch-ingest one or more YouTube podcast playlists end-to-end. Each episode flows through: enumeration → transcript fetch → parse/clean → **fidelity review** (quality gate) → full pipeline (KB storage, NER entity extraction, vectorization, CocoIndex knowledge graph, Mem0).
286	
287	```bash
288	# One or more playlist URLs (plain video URLs also accepted)
289	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL..." [MORE_URLS...]
290	
291	# From a file (one URL per line, # comments allowed), with vector store upload
292	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py --from-file playlists.txt --upload
293	
294	# Preview a new playlist's caption quality without ingesting
295	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --limit 5 --dry-run
296	
297	# Stricter gate + LLM coherence pass (FIDELITY_REVIEW_MODEL, default gpt-5.5)
298	python scripts/playlist_ingestion.py <URL> --min-fidelity 0.6 --llm-review
299	```
300	
301	Flags: `--upload` (OpenAI vector store), `--no-kb`, `--limit N` (per playlist), `--force` (reprocess done episodes), `--dry-run`, `--min-fidelity 0.45`, `--llm-review`, `--delay 2.0` (seconds between episodes), `--state-file PATH`.
302	
303	**Resume is automatic**: state is checkpointed to `data/playlist_ingestion/state.json` after every episode; re-runs skip `ingested`/`quarantined` episodes and retry `failed`/`no_transcript` ones.
304	
305	**Fidelity review** (`lib/transcript_fidelity.py`) scores each transcript 0–1 from coverage, speech density (wpm), caption gaps, artifact ratio, and repetition; verdicts: `pass` ≥ 0.7, `review` ≥ 0.45, `fail` < 0.45. Failing/below-threshold episodes are **quarantined** (transcript + fidelity JSON kept on disk, not ingested). Artifacts: cleaned transcripts in `data/playlist_ingestion/transcripts/`, per-episode fidelity reports and per-run markdown summaries in `data/playlist_ingestion/reports/`.
306	
307	See [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) for stage internals, state schema, quarantine review workflow, and tuning.
308	
309	## Content Type Detection
310	
311	YouTube: URL contains `youtube.com` or `youtu.be`. Web: starts with `http(s)://`. File: everything else (validated with `os.path.exists`).
312	
313	## Extending the Pipeline
314	
315	Add stages in `process_url()` or `process_file()` following this pattern:
316	
317	```python
318	if result and result.get('doc_id'):
319	    try:
320	        processing_steps.append("New stage")
321	        # ... processing logic ...
322	    except Exception as e:
323	        logger.warning(f"New stage skipped: {e}")
324	```
325	
326	## File Relocation
327	
328	Processed files from `data/processing_queue/` auto-move to `packages/knowledge-base/sources/files/`.
329	
330	## Troubleshooting
331	
332	- **Module not found**: Activate `.venv`, run `pip install -r requirements.txt`
333	- **API key errors**: Source `.env` or export `OPENAI_API_KEY` manually
334	- **CocoIndex unavailable**: `pip install cocoindex` + configure PostgreSQL/Neo4j
335	- **Mem0 disabled**: Set `MEM0_API_KEY` env var
336	- **Upstash sync skipped**: Set `UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL` + `UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN`
337	
338	## References
339	
340	- [Pipeline architecture details](references/pipeline-architecture.md) -- module relationships, data flow, and integration points
341	- [Playlist ingestion details](references/playlist-ingestion.md) -- playlist pipeline stages, fidelity scoring, state/resume, quarantine workflow
342
```

71	## Processing Pipeline
72	
73	```
74	Input (URL/YouTube/File)
75	  |-> Content Extraction
76	  |     YouTube: lib/youtube.py transcript extraction
77	  |     Web: processing/web_content_processor.py scraping
78	  |     File: direct read (supports .md, .pdf, .txt — NOT .docx; use bulk ingestion for docx)
79	  |
80	  |-> Knowledge Base Storage (lib/knowledge_base_crud.py)
81	  |     Indexes content, assigns doc_id
82	  |
83	  |-> Upstash Search Sync (lib/sync_to_upstash_search_integrated.py)
84	  |     Syncs to frontend search index (if configured)
85	  |
86	  |-> Entity Extraction (lib/entity_extraction/)
87	  |     NER + Xata database matching (85-95% accuracy)
88	  |     Extracts: personnel, organizations, locations, events
89	  |
90	  |-> CocoIndex Knowledge Graph (lib/cocoindex_integration.py)
91	  |     Builds entity relationships (requires PostgreSQL + Neo4j)
92	  |
93	  |-> Mem0 Contextual Memory (lib/mem0_integration.py)
94	  |     Stores processing summaries, entity memories
95	  |
96	  |-> Upstash Queue (lib/upstash/queue.py)
97	       QStash async processing for downstream consumers
98	```
99	
100	Each stage is fault-tolerant -- failures log warnings but never block the pipeline.
101

160	
161	9 entity types extracted from UAP content:
162	
163	| Type | Key Fields |
164	|------|-----------|
165	| `PERSON` | role, credibility(1-10), authority(1-10), bio |
166	| `EVENT` | title, datetime, location(coordinates), metadata |
